subject: google search for deployed shiny app

messages.author: 69ac3ae0147ab554
messages.subject: google search for deployed shiny app
parts:
Hello,

When I google my deployed shinyapp on google it will not show. How do I make sure future users can find my app through google?
At the moment it is hosted on the free package. Does it require a more advanced package?

Best wishes,

Bas

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: google search for deployed shiny app
parts:
There are a few threads in the group about crawlers and robots.txt, e.g. https://groups.google.com/d/msg/shinyapps-users/UtRAfVXUtbU/9EgpNTwhFAAJ

Short answer is that we don't allow bots to crawl shinyapps.io because they don't actually make the additional calls to obtain the content and therefore cause useless load on the system and consumer accounts' hours with no benefit.
